caveats: The five clauses were measured after the kill-gate was not passed; they are recorded and do not decide the verdict. The 11 scored summaries hold 0 marker statements under the default reader, so no pair of the 55 and no band edge exercises the registered mechanism (equal marker statements of two documents that exchange mass); this run does not show what a structural reader does to the distance between two documents that both hold markers, apart from the one cross-article pair read outside the record. The readers differ on 3 of 11 summaries through segmentation, not through markers: the markdown reader passes each paragraph to the segmenter on its own (the segmenter on the paragraph alone returns the statement count of auto for 3 of 3). Clause 2 reads equal bands when the documents that set the edges and the reference keep their statements: embedded lists equal under both readers {'adv2-b': True, 'gold': True, 'haiku': True}. Clause 3: 28 of 55 pairs hold two documents with equal statement lists and read the same float under both readers; the correlation over the other 27 is 0.9597. Clause 4 is read on renders of one generator (markdown_it, commonmark with tables); HTML from other tools was not read. The band is in-sample on 11 documents and each edge is one document (E12-H63). The Wergeland article has 0 adversarial-tier documents and its 6 stored documents are statement lists without a file, so no band was read for it; detect_format reads the Wergeland files as {'raw-extract.txt': 'markdown', 'source-article.md': 'markdown'}, and raw-extract.txt is a text extract of the PDF. Executor rules, because the record leaves them open: the marker rule (no letter and no digit), the pair order of baseline.py, the band shift read on each edge, n_unsupported through unsupported_count against the ibm source, match_status counts against the ibm source with the reference pairs as second reading, the threshold position as lower edge < threshold <= upper edge, and direction_matched as the two effects of the prediction that have a direction. Executor note on the run: before the notebook was built, one probe read the two gate conditions without any distance, and a second probe after it computed the distances of both arms to fix the table layout. The notebook was then executed 6 times, the first stopped at an import error; the changes between executions concerned tables, wording, three second readings (the segmenter on one paragraph alone, summary statements under 5 words, the marker strings of the pair read outside the record), one figure axis and one progress bar; none of them changed a registered bar, threshold or constant. Two markdown cells were reworded after the last execution; every code cell and every output is from that execution
